results.content:
4.5 hours of manual work becomes 3.5 minutes.

Most teams stitch together a handful of tools to run ads. Adside does all of it, so you cancel the rest.

One tool to replace them all

Run it yourself, or have us run it for you.

A team of agents that run your ads on Google, Meta, LinkedIn, Reddit and Twitter.

Your AI agency, plus an expert human from our network to manage it. The best of both worlds!

We're Robin and Guillaume. Before Adside, we bootstrapped a software company together, sold it, and learned to run our own ads profitably along the way.

Managing the ads was an operational nightmare, and we burnt a lot of money in the process. We decided to work on self-driving ads and solve that.

Robin Choy, CEO & Guillaume Miara, CTO

Read our story [...] An AI team that researches your market, drafts a strategy, creates static and video ads, monitors your accounts, rotates creatives, and much more. Managed by you, or by one of our human experts.

Research your market in minutes

Track any competitor and pull their live ads into one board. We tell you when they launch something new.

We watch X, Reddit and G2 so you know what the market is saying, and which angles your competitors are testing.

Not sure who to watch? Adside finds the competitors that matter in your niche and tracks them for you.

Paid ads used to be complex and scattered. Use Adside to manage all your different platforms in one place, and replace all your other tools.

4.5 hours of manual work becomes 3.5 minutes. [...] No. The platform takes the repetitive work off their plate, like building campaigns, resizing creative and pulling reports, so your people spend their time on strategy and winning new business. And if you don't have an ads team at all, that's what the managed service is for: an expert from our network runs everything for you.

Two ways. AI Agency: $990 per brand, per month ($490 with annual prepay), and everything is included — research, creative, reporting and operations, with $100 of creative credits every month and no per-seat fees. Managed service: 10% of your ad spend, with a $2,500 monthly minimum — strategy, creative production, launch and reporting all included. An expert from our network runs everything.

results.content: Adside AI (F26) builds a swarm of agents that finds the most profitable paid strategies for you and runs them across Batch Meta, Google, LinkedIn, and more. This isn’t yet another Higgsfield killer or AI ad generator. Adside agents manage the entire creative loop across every channel: they generate, import, and rotate creatives, fine-tune audiences, optimize bidding and keyword targeting, and run A/B tests. Like a world-class agency would, but with agents instead of people. Congrats on the launch, Robin and Guillaume! 🚀
